main_body: A stilt farm hut: a large plank roof slab (rows 0-21) over a plank-wall body (rows 22-35) with a small door and window, a porch ledge, and thin stilts below.
top_band: Only a 1-row light highlight (#d9a566) at row 1 under the outline; below it the roof planks (L~98-131) continue as one face down to row 20, with no step to a separate top band.
evidence: The roof is drawn as a flat vertical plank panel with vertical boards and only a 1px highlight at the top edge, so no roof slope reads as a surface seen from above. The wall below is also a flat front elevation with a door and window. The darker bottom roof rows (16-20) form an eave shadow, but they are part of the same face. This is a front elevation with a hat line, not a 3/4 building, and fails the contract.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 8 distinct colours and a median of 7 per tile, against 185 and 18 for house-h101_0 and 66 and 11 for house-h112_0-stone. It has about 4 brown steps, and the plank texture is just vertical stripes with a few dashes. The outline is a dark brown tint with 0% neutral edge pixels, which suits the wood, and there are no 5x5 flat fills. It is far thinner than the references in shading and detail, with no per-plank grain or highlights, so it fails on density and shading depth.
